rationale: Pratik's expertise in LLM inference, language model training, and ML infrastructure at Apple complements Sankeerth's work building practical AI agents at Agentin AI (YC). With overlapping focus on llm-tooling and ml-research, plus Sankeerth's conviction that agentic AI is the next frontier, Pratik's hands-on experience deploying production ML systems could inform how Agentin AI tackles real-world agent deployability.
intro_message: Pratik Doshi, meet Sankeerth Rao Karingula — you both work in llm-tooling and ml-research, and Sankeerth's building practical AI agents while Pratik's deployed LLM inference systems at Apple; could be a good fit to explore deployment challenges together.
